_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Union Bank of India Union UNI-CARBON Credit Card (HPCL co-brand)
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Card page features table: "1 Reward Point = Rs. 0.25" (Union Bank of India card page read 2026-11-15). Not repeated in the KFS or MITC.

action.reason: 16 reward points (equal to Rs 4 cashback, 4%) per Rs 100 on fuel at HPCL authorised outlets on transactions of Rs 500 and above, up to Rs 150 per billing cycle per card (card page).
2 points per Rs 100 on non-fuel spend (card page); 1 point = Rs 0.25.

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: No separate DCC markup is stated in the issuer documents read

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee Rs 550 + GST waived if card spend in the last 12 months is Rs 1,00,000 (KFS). Joining fee Rs 499 for the primary card.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: Up to Rs 300 credited to the bill if the customer purchases fuel worth Rs 300 or more at an HPCL authorised outlet within 60 days of activation (card page).

spend_milestones.label: 500 bonus points at Rs 1,25,000 annual spend (page; cumulative 500)

lifestyle_and_network_benefits.label: Accidental insurance Rs 10 lakh (premium borne by NPCI) plus an additional Rs 10 lakh (premium borne by cardholder)

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

MITC, Credit Cards (PDF created 22 Apr 2026): same fee tables as the KFS
UNI-CARBON card page: welcome and cashback benefits, rewards, fuel waiver, milestones
sources.read: plain page fetch; tab content read from the page source

open_questions: Reward points exclusions: the KFS lists excluded MCCs (jewellery, fuel, cash withdrawal, bitcoin, wallet loading, alcohol and wine shops, insurance) only for Unicorn and Nexteria. For the other cards the page says only "no reward points on cash withdrawals" (FAQ); the full list of MCCs that earn nothing is not published ("eligible MCCs prescribed by Bank time to time").

Fuel surcharge waiver wording differs: the card pages say "per billing cycle"; the KFS and MITC say "per month". The page wording is used. The surcharge the acquirer charges at the pump (the amount being waived) is not stated, and no minimum transaction value is stated except for UNI CARBON (Rs 200 and above).
KFS and MITC say all fees are exclusive of GST; the 18% rate is taken from the worked examples in the same documents (GST of Rs 36 on a Rs 200 fee).
Reward-point value: the card page states 1 Reward Point = Rs 0.25. The KFS and MITC do not repeat it.
Both PDFs are Version 1.4 with no printed effective date; the file creation date (22 Apr 2026) is the only date available.

Billing-cycle cap: the page says the 4% HPCL cashback is "up to a maximum of Rs 150 per billing cycle per card"; modelled as a Rs 150 cap on the cashback amount per billing cycle (the cap metric used is the rupee value of the cashback, not spend).
On HP Pay app payments the page adds 1.5% cash back as 6 HP loyalty points credited to the HP Pay app (HPCL points); modelled as a partner offer without a rupee cap. Total savings stated: 6.5%.
Beyond Rs 2,00,000 annual spend the page says 1,000 additional points for every Rs 50,000 in a billing year; not modelled as a step.

Fuel excluded from the 2-point rate ("non-fuel transactions"); HPCL fuel earns the 16-point cashback rate only at HPCL outlets on Rs 500 and above; fuel elsewhere earns nothing. Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% on Rs 200 and above at HPCL outlets, Rs 100 per billing cycle.
